title: The Lost Sheep, Coin, and Son

questions.question: Why did the Pharisees and the scribes grumble against Jesus at the beginning of Luke 15?
options: "This man receives sinners and eats with them."
"He does not fast on Mondays and Thursdays."
"He refuses to read the Torah properly in the synagogue."
"He claims to be the King of the Jews."
questions.correctAnswer: "This man receives sinners and eats with them."
questions.explanation: Luke 15:2 (ESV): "And the Pharisees and the scribes grumbled, saying, 'This man receives sinners and eats with them.'"

questions.question: In the Parable of the Lost Sheep, a man has a hundred sheep and loses one. What does he do?
options: He leaves the ninety-nine in the open country, and goes after the one that is lost, until he finds it
He mourns for a day and hires shepherds to search
He sells the ninety-nine to buy ten new sheep
He ignores the lost sheep considering it a small cost of business
questions.correctAnswer: He leaves the ninety-nine in the open country, and goes after the one that is lost, until he finds it
questions.explanation: Luke 15:4 (ESV): "What man of you, having a hundred sheep, if he has lost one of them, does not leave the ninety-nine in the open country, and go after the one that is lost, until he finds it?"

questions.question: What does Jesus say happens in heaven over one sinner who repents?
options: There will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents than over ninety-nine righteous persons who need no repentance
A star is born in the sky for all the world to see
An angel sings a new song before the throne
A new room is added to the Father's house instantly
questions.correctAnswer: There will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents than over ninety-nine righteous persons who need no repentance
questions.explanation: Luke 15:7 (ESV): "Just so, I tell you, there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents than over ninety-nine righteous persons who need no repentance."

questions.question: In the Parable of the Lost Coin, how many silver coins did the woman originally have?
options: Ten silver coins
Thirty pieces of silver
Five gold coins
A hundred copper pennies
questions.explanation: Luke 15:8 (ESV): "Or what woman, having ten silver coins, if she loses one coin, does not light a lamp and sweep the house and seek diligently until she finds it?"

questions.question: In the Parable of the Prodigal Son, what did the younger son ask his father to give him?
options: "Father, give me the share of property that is coming to me."
"Father, give me the finest rings in your house."
"Father, allow me to manage all the servants today."
"Father, give me ten sheep and a horse to travel."
questions.correctAnswer: "Father, give me the share of property that is coming to me."
questions.explanation: Luke 15:12 (ESV): "And the younger of them said to his father, 'Father, give me the share of property that is coming to me.' And he divided his property between them."

questions.question: What did the younger son do with his property in a far country?
options: He squandered his property in reckless living
He bought land which produced a famine
He was robbed of it all by Roman soldiers
He invested it poorly in a failing market
questions.correctAnswer: He squandered his property in reckless living
questions.explanation: Luke 15:13 (ESV): "Not many days later, the younger son gathered all he had and took a journey into a far country, and there he squandered his property in reckless living."

questions.question: When a severe famine arose and he was in need, what humiliating job did the younger son take?
options: He was sent into the fields to feed pigs
He worked as a servant hauling water for a tax collector
He became a beggar outside the synagogue
He had to weave baskets from scrap wood
questions.correctAnswer: He was sent into the fields to feed pigs
questions.explanation: Luke 15:15 (ESV): "So he went and hired himself out to one of the citizens of that country, who sent him into his fields to feed pigs."

questions.question: The son was so hungry he longed to eat what the pigs were eating. What were the pigs eating?
options: Pods that the pigs ate
Rotten grain
Acorns and bitter herbs
Worms found in the dirt
questions.explanation: Luke 15:16 (ESV): "And he was longing to be fed with the pods that the pigs ate, and no one gave him anything."

questions.question: When he "came to himself," what did he realize about his father's hired servants?
options: "How many of my father's hired servants have more than enough bread, but I perish here with hunger!"
"My father's servants are well dressed, but I am in rags!"
"They sleep in warm beds, but I freeze in this pen!"
"Even the dogs under the table eat the scraps of meat!"
questions.correctAnswer: "How many of my father's hired servants have more than enough bread, but I perish here with hunger!"
questions.explanation: Luke 15:17 (ESV): "But when he came to himself, he said, 'How many of my father's hired servants have more than enough bread, but I perish here with hunger!'"

questions.question: The son practiced what he would say to his father. He determined to say: "Father, I have sinned against heaven and before you. I am no longer worthy to be called your son. Treat me as..." what?
options: As one of your hired servants
As a poor beggar at your gate
As a stranger from another town
As a slave for the rest of my years
questions.correctAnswer: As one of your hired servants
questions.explanation: Luke 15:18-19 (ESV): "...I am no longer worthy to be called your son. Treat me as one of your hired servants."

questions.question: When the son was still a long way off, his father saw him and felt compassion. What did the father do?
options: He ran and embraced him and kissed him
He fell to his knees in prayer
He ordered servants to stop him at the gate and clean him
He turned his back until the son approached him
questions.correctAnswer: He ran and embraced him and kissed him
questions.explanation: Luke 15:20 (ESV): "But while he was still a long way off, his father saw him and felt compassion, and ran and embraced him and kissed him."

questions.question: What three items did the father command his servants to instantly bring and put on the returning son?
options: The best robe, a ring on his hand, and shoes on his feet
A crown of gold, a sword, and a new shield
A silver tunic, a leather belt, and clean sandals
A staff, a coat of many colors, and a gold chain
questions.correctAnswer: The best robe, a ring on his hand, and shoes on his feet
questions.explanation: Luke 15:22 (ESV): "But the father said to his servants, 'Bring quickly the best robe, and put it on him, and put a ring on his hand, and shoes on his feet.'"

questions.question: What animal did the father command to be brought and killed for the celebration?
options: The fattened calf
A spotless lamb without blemish
A fatted goat
Three fine sheep
questions.explanation: Luke 15:23 (ESV): "And bring the fattened calf and kill it, and let us eat and celebrate."

questions.question: How did the older son react when he heard music and dancing and found out his brother had returned and the fattened calf was killed?
options: He was angry and refused to go in
He wept for joy and rushed into the feast
He went in, but sat quietly in the corner
He immediately attacked the musicians outside
questions.correctAnswer: He was angry and refused to go in
questions.explanation: Luke 15:28 (ESV): "But he was angry and refused to go in. His father came out and entreated him,"

questions.question: The older son complained that he served many years and never disobeyed, yet the father never gave him even a young goat to celebrate with his friends. What was the father's final reply to him?
options: "Son, you are always with me, and all that is mine is yours. It was fitting to celebrate and be glad, for this your brother was dead, and is alive; he was lost, and is found."
"Do not question my authority in my own house, step inside immediately."
"Those who remain faithful will inherit the earth in time."
"If you wish, you may take a lamb tomorrow."
questions.correctAnswer: "Son, you are always with me, and all that is mine is yours. It was fitting to celebrate and be glad, for this your brother was dead, and is alive; he was lost, and is found."
questions.explanation: Luke 15:31-32 (ESV): "And he said to him, 'Son, you are always with me, and all that is mine is yours. It was fitting to celebrate and be glad, for this your brother was dead, and is alive; he was lost, and is found.'"

key_verse_text: "Just so, I tell you, there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents than over ninety-nine righteous persons who need no repentance."
